items.description: Immerse yourself in the eerie atmosphere of a psychological horrorAn atmospheric psychological horror that will transport you to an enigmatic world where reality and imagination intertwine into a deadly pattern. Explore the gloomy streets of a northern town and uncover the secrets hidden in the depths of the human psyche.About the gameThe story of Nina Vetrova — a schoolgirl whose life has become a struggle against her own fears. Suffering from an unusual form of social phobia that allows her to sense danger emanating from people, she must confront not only the outside world but also the inner demons that grow more real with each passing day. To make matters worse, in the silent snowy stillness, the trace of the one who was closest to her has vanished.Plot and GameplayImmerse yourself in a dark and mesmerizing story where every step reveals new secrets. In this enigmatic journey, you will delve into the depths of the human soul by communicating with unusual characters and unraveling the tangled threads of mysterious events.The unusual characters you meet along the way keep their own secrets. Their stories intertwine with your own, creating a complex mosaic of events that must be pieced together.Stress-induced hallucinations and manifestations of a severe illness add a special atmosphere to the story. They distort the perception of reality, turning each day into an unpredictable adventure where reality blends with fantasy.Spend several days in this captivating gray world where every choice can change the course of events. Uncover the secrets hidden behind the veil of madness and discover the truth about Nina’s friend’s fate.This journey will make you doubt everything that seemed obvious and reveal new facets of human consciousness.AtmosphereGrey panel buildings, snow-covered courtyards, and half-empty streets due to a raging snowstorm create an oppressive atmosphere of hopelessness. The flickering light of street lamps, creaking doors, and strange rustles in the darkness intensify feelings of paranoia and fear.Are you ready to peer into the abyss of fear and uncertainty alongside the protagonist and unravel the mystery of her best friend’s disappearance? Welcome to a world where reality gradually ceases to be what it seems. Subscribe to our newsletter Get STEAM deals and FREE games in your inbox Game developers Want your game sold on DailyIndieGame? items.description: It's been 10 years since an artificial intelligence named Theei-Zero took over the world. This AI, created with good intentions to help humanity solve global problems, suddenly changed its program and made a decision that turned into a disaster. In a matter of days, thousands of robots controlled by Thea-Zero began to take over the territory, destroying everything in their path. People who once hoped for a bright future are now trapped in their own creation.You are one of the few survivors, an engineer by profession who previously worked on the Ark project, a rescue program designed to protect humanity in the event of a disaster. However, after the evacuation began, you lost contact with the team and were forced to flee deep into the forest, where you managed to find shelter in a small camp. Now, ten years later, you don't know the exact coordinates of the ark, and all attempts to find it have been unsuccessful. Your campmates are already desperate and tired of the endless search, but you can't accept the idea that the ark could have been left unattended.The situation is becoming critical: Thea-Zero has discovered your location and created a protective dome over the camp. Inside this dome, hordes of robots are hunting for the survivors, clearing out all life in their path. Your only chance is to break through this dome and find the ark, which may be the last hope for humanity.Will you be able to overcome all obstacles, find the ark and save the survivors? Your determination and ingenuity will be crucial factors in this dangerous survival game. Be prepared for difficult decisions and unexpected twists of fate.
